figure.name: ALF
figure.breakdown: An alien with a kitchen and a family, performed by a man who refused for four years to say how. Children cried when it ended, and the character was invited to birthday parties.
figure.why_today: Today's edition: The Person You Watched. This figure is the record's case for it.
figure.tell: What makes it more than a technique note is that the withholding was deliberate and stated as method: 'Fusco insists that many people believe in Alf just as they believe in Santa Claus, and he is not about to spoil the illusion.

persona.title: Two women died in the same month and the discourse is about whether you are allowed to be sad
persona.why: Two deaths in a month and a discourse about whether you are allowed to be sad. Grief treated them identically and accused of not knowing the difference - the archive register doing its usual work on two idols.

character.title: The NEST letter
character.why: A child writes to a magazine about a fictional brand of baby food. The brand never appears, the letter is never answered, and the episode ends - an attachment to a mascot held by a five-year-old with no reciprocity available at all.

companion.title: Not all ghosts are bad
companion.why: A ghost, and the reason the haunted member exists: belief in presence with nothing to verify it. Filed social-agent rather than object because he is addressed, not used.

divine.title: The icon answers nothing
divine.why: Filed divine/christ, on the shelf's own test: "Is the relationship expressed by being addressed rather than by being watched, and is the other end understood to hear?" The icon is not watched; it is venerated, kissed, carried in procession and censed.

institution.title: Transnational fandom
institution.why: Fans organising across national borders around media, with a shared calendar of releases and a shared language. A body that ignores the state, which is why it is institutional rather than a sub-culture.

cosmology.title: The Neighbours finale broke something in the schedule
cosmology.why: Not just grief: the shape of a whole country's week rearranged around a soap ending. The clearest documented case that the slot can matter more than the thing in it.

officer.title: A 27-year marriage ends and the coverage is about what the public felt
officer.why: A 27-year marriage ends and the coverage is about what the public felt, with readers asked to be honest about it. A person known as a neighbour rather than as a performer, which is why this is the local officer case and not the idol one.

predator.title: Swatting
predator.why: A false emergency report sent to a real address to provoke an armed police response, because of a grievance about a streamer. Armed enforcement summoned by an attachment, which is the worst version of the register.
